## Recopy v1.11.1 - Image Thumbnails Are Back

A hotfix for v1.11.0.

### Fixes

- **Image thumbnails in the panel:** on macOS, v1.11.0 showed a placeholder instead of the thumbnail for every image item, while the preview still worked. Thumbnails now load again. Your images and history were never affected.

### Downloads

| Platform | File |
| --- | --- |
| macOS (Apple Silicon) | `Recopy_1.11.1_aarch64.dmg` |
| macOS (Intel) | `Recopy_1.11.1_x64.dmg` |
| Windows (64-bit) | `Recopy_1.11.1_x64-setup.exe` |

### Notes

- **macOS:** The app is not notarized yet. On first launch: right-click → Open → confirm. See the [Installation Guide](https://github.com/shiqkuangsan/Recopy/blob/main/docs/macos-unsigned-app.md).
- No clipboard database schema changes relative to v1.11.0.
- Verified: 396 frontend tests (including a regression test for this issue), 93 Rust tests (one opt-in performance test skipped), locked Cargo tests, CI build checks for macOS and Windows, and a hands-on check of thumbnails in a local macOS release build.

## Recopy v1.11.1 - 图片缩略图回来了

v1.11.0 的修复版本。

### 修复

- **面板中的图片缩略图：** 在 macOS 上，v1.11.0 的面板里每个图片条目都只显示占位图标，但预览正常。现在缩略图已恢复显示。你的图片和历史记录都没有受到影响。

### 下载

| 平台 | 文件 |
| --- | --- |
| macOS（Apple Silicon） | `Recopy_1.11.1_aarch64.dmg` |
| macOS（Intel） | `Recopy_1.11.1_x64.dmg` |
| Windows（64 位） | `Recopy_1.11.1_x64-setup.exe` |

### 说明

- **macOS：** 应用尚未公证。首次打开：右键 → 打开 → 确认。详见[安装指南](https://github.com/shiqkuangsan/Recopy/blob/main/docs/macos-unsigned-app.md)。
- 相比 v1.11.0，不包含剪贴板数据库结构变更。
- 验证情况：396 项前端测试（含针对本问题的回归测试）、93 项 Rust 测试（跳过一项按需运行的性能测试）、locked Cargo 测试、CI 中 macOS 与 Windows 的构建检查，以及在本地 macOS 正式版构建中实际查看缩略图。
